name: 2D Curve Point Info
description: 用于得到2D曲线点的角平分线和角度

o.0: 正确长度的角平分线向量
o.1: 归一化的角平分线向量

outputs.name: Bisector
outputs.description: Directional vector pointing central between next and previous edge of a face corner
outputs.de: Directional vector pointing central between next and previous edge of a face corner
outputs.dz: 设置 Bisector 的向量数据。

outputs.name: nBisector
outputs.dz: 设置 n / Bisector 的向量数据。

outputs.name: Corner Angle
outputs.description: Angle between the next and previous edge of a face corner within the face
outputs.de: Angle between the next and previous edge of a face corner within the face
outputs.dz: 设置 Corner / 角度 的数值。
